_about: Title list for the key-idea summaries shelf (pipeline step 1). Snapshot of Amazon's best-seller lists, deduplicated across formats and editions, with non-books and off-topic titles removed. 'rank' is the order to generate in. 'faith' marks Christian-living titles so they can be filtered as a group. 'rights' decides the source: public_domain_us titles are summarized from the full text Focus Reader can serve; in_copyright titles are summarized from the model's knowledge, never from a copy of the book. 'next_up' are the replacements, in order, for any title you drop.

source.ordering: Self-Help rank first; titles not in the Self-Help top 100 follow by their best rank in the other three lists. Amazon ranks are hourly, so this is a point-in-time order.
excluded_when: illustrated gift book too short to summarize without substituting for it
memoir or poetry without a life-advice frame
non-English edition of a listed work
